Causes: stem_density's early exit if (base > amp) return 0 with amp = 0.6r, while noise plus jet displacement reaches about 0.88r, which gives a hard cut along the flared and waisted stem envelope (the arcs and the cup). sdf_stem's dv = p.y - stem.y top plane, together with the proxy top mx.y = ss.top + sr, cuts per-jet tops (top_j up to about 1.32h) flat. The axis singularity of cs creates the lone central jet (the pillar).

Add the axis blend from Mk 82 (removes the pillar). explosion.gd _update_volume: stem proxy top = ss.top*1.4 + sr; add a soft density fade within 3% of each proxy face, so any remaining clipping is never a hard line.

issues.problem: At 0.6 s the eruption overflows the frame on the top, left and right (phase-0 FOV fitted to the vent). At 0.3 s the heave mound sits half below the bottom edge. STEM AXIS SINGULARITY (sev 2-3, all four): in stem_density, cs = p.xz/rx is undefined at the axis, so the jet noise and per-jet top_j flip across rx -> 0. Fix: w_ax = smoothstep(0.05r, 0.45r, rx); jet = mix(0.55, jet, w_ax); top_j = mix(stem.x + 0.8*(stem.y-stem.x), top_j, w_ax).

Fix: early exit at 1.0r plus a smoothstep(r, 0.7r, base) fade; dv at stem.y*1.4 when stem_cone > 0; proxy top ss.top*1.4 + sr; a soft density fade near the proxy box faces.

CONDENSATION SHEETS (sev 2-3): in explosion_volume, the ring term displaces the SDF by (n-0.5)*rr*0.35 in all directions (rr = largest ring radius, 5-16 km). Sheets thinner than the step dt render as radial comb stripes and stipple (Mike 180 s, Bravo 90-180 s). Fix: separate the noise, using a vertical term th*0.4*(n_lo-0.5) and a radial rim term R*0.08*(n_edge-0.5): dr = smoothstep(th*0.5, -th*0.5, max(abs(p.y-y0) - th*(0.8+0.4*n_lo), r - R*(0.92+0.16*n_edge))). Inside |p.y-y0| < 3*th, exclude the sheet from the empty-space skip and force dt <= 0.5*th. Ice caps should be thin draped lenses hugging the dome top, abs(sd_ellipsoid(q, vec3(R, H*1.1, R))) - th, restricted to q.y > 0.3H, not separate pancakes.
